title: When Your Team Scores at the World Cup 😱⚽
script: You can feel the stadium shake before the ball even hits the net. The roar of 80,000 fans hits you like a wall. Every stranger becomes your best friend in that one second. The ground vibrates. The flags wave as one. You jump. You scream. You hug the person next to you — you don't even know their name. This is why we watch. This is why we live for this moment.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long dark hair, red team jersey, sits in packed World Cup stadium, eyes locked on the pitch [Static shot, wide angle showing sea of fans]. Goal is scored — stadium erupts — she jumps up with both arms raised high, screaming with pure joy [Tracking shot following her jump upward]. Confetti rains down, flags wave wildly, crowd surges [Push in on her face, eyes closed, elated smile]. Second clip: she grabs the stranger next to her and they hug and jump together [Tracking shot sweeping across celebrating crowd]. Stadium lights blaze, fireworks flash, the moment freezes [Pull out to reveal full stadium grandeur, aerial feel]. Live World Cup stadium, night match, electric atmosphere, cinematic lighting, 9:16 portrait.
